$comment: Laid down by claude-spine. Every hook here is verified by `claude-spine doctor` against real known-bad payloads. A hook file that is not listed in this block never runs — doctor checks that too.

permissions.$comment: HONEST LIMIT: the wildcard denies below are honoured by Read and Edit but NOT by Glob (anthropics/claude-code#78752), so those trees can still be enumerated even though reading a file in them is blocked. On Windows, deny also matches the literal path string with no canonicalisation, so a path containing spaces or long components can be reached via its 8.3 short alias (PROGRA~1). Neither is fixable from here — both are upstream. `claude-spine doctor` flags every deny rule of yours with this shape, including these. A deny rule you cannot walk past is worth having; one you can is worth knowing about.
